title: runner: give StepAttemptOutcome a deliberate home

raw.title: runner: give StepAttemptOutcome a deliberate home
raw.body:
\`StepAttemptOutcome\` lives in \`packages/runner/src/executor/StepRetryRunner.ts\` while being produced by \`StepExecutor\` and consumed by \`WorkflowExecutor\`'s loop — its current home is arbitrary (a leftover of where it was first needed) and is the one type placement worth revisiting before the API surface freezes.

Decide the owning module (likely \`StepExecutor\`, as the producer defining the contract) and move it, updating the \`@internal\`/public categorization as part of the move.

Part of the pre-1.0 cleanup train feeding the API surface review.
